title: Adventure Studio Document, Workspace & Authority Contract
objective: Establish the creator-facing Adventure Studio document/workspace and authority contract that binds prepared Adventure content to existing CSW, CNI, Adventure, Scene, Session, Quest, World, Character, Encounter, Action/Event and resource owners through explicit references and proposals while preserving the boundary between prepared definitions and live runtime occurrences.
roadmap_prerequisites: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json MAS start gate re-evaluated after CNI-11 completion
CSW/Adventure/Scene/Session contracts and ARI remain required upstream authorities and are not replaced by MAS

scope.purpose: Define the first MAS workspace/document contract and authority boundaries for Adventure authoring without creating a second narrative runtime or canonical owner-domain store.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically represent an Adventure-authoring document and prepared content bindings, distinguishes draft/prepared/published projections from live occurrences, references existing owner-domain objects without duplicating their authority, preserves CSW/CNI/ARI/D29 boundaries, and exposes unsupported or invalid bindings without silently mutating canonical state.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 creates no canonical Adventure, Scene, Session, Quest, World, Character, Encounter, Investigation or Action/Event state authority.
CSW remains pre-authoritative creative/storycraft workspace authority and CNI remains modular conditional-content/runtime authority.
ARI remains resource identity/rights authority and D29 remains authoring provenance authority.
Prepared definitions never prove a live occurrence; live-occurrence requests fail closed.
Visibility filtering is applied before projected lists/counts and optional AI remains proposal-only.
Validation Core transitioned once from CNI to MAS at this family boundary, sealed the completed CNI-11 application baseline and retired prior-family automatic validation.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-01; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked by MAS-01, so MAS-02 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-03+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.

proof_diagnostic.disposition: test_fixture_literal_type_narrowing_only; production and governance behavior unchanged

plan_adjustments.reason: The first full proof run exposed TypeScript literal narrowing only in the invalid/unsupported focused test fixture after runtime and source-governance proof were already green.
plan_adjustments.change: Rewrote the two test cases as immutable overridden input arrays with explicit literal states; no production or governance code changed.

next_action: MAS-01 is closed. MAS-02 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
